module.purpose: Provides local persistence and cross-tab synchronization for a TLStore using IndexedDB and BroadcastChannel messaging.
module.summary: This module coordinates loading, migrating, persisting, and synchronizing editor document and session state. It listens to document and session changes, broadcasts document diffs to other tabs, throttles IndexedDB writes, retries failed writes through full snapshots, and protects newer schema versions from being overwritten by older clients. Browser lifecycle events flush pending changes before page suspension or unload.
module.businessContext: Supports reliable local editing for the tldraw editor across browser tabs. Failures can lose unsaved document or session state, cause schema conflicts, or prevent collaboration between local tabs.

detail.summary: TLLocalSyncClient coordinates local document and session-state synchronization between a TLStore, IndexedDB persistence, and other browser tabs. It exposes the persistence identity, store, database, and broadcast channel used by its synchronization lifecycle.

units.name: connect

detail.name: connect
detail.signature: private async connect(onLoad: (client: this) => void, onLoadError: (error: Error) => void)
preconditions: The client has initialized its database, store, synchronization channel, session identifier, serialized schema, and document type set.
onLoad and onLoadError are callable callbacks.
postconditions: On successful initialization, compatible persisted document records and session state are loaded, the channel message handler is installed, an announce message is posted, channel cleanup is registered, didLoad is set to true, and onLoad is called with this client.
If the client was disposed after loading completes, initialization stops without invoking onLoad.
If loading or migration fails, onLoadError is called and normal initialization does not complete.
invariants: Only records whose typeName is in the document type set are merged into the store.
Persisted records are migrated using the stored schema when present, otherwise the earliest serialized schema.
A received message with an incompatible schema is not applied as a diff.
A received compatible diff is applied inside a transaction and remote-change merge.
edgeCases: If IndexedDB loading rejects, the error is passed to onLoadError, the inability-to-read alert is shown, and initialization returns.
If no persisted data is returned, no records or session snapshot are restored, but channel setup and onLoad still occur.
If a persisted snapshot has no sessionStateSnapshot, session state is extracted from the legacy document snapshot.
If migration returns an error, onLoadError receives an Error whose message begins with 'Failed to migrate store:' and no loaded callback is invoked.
If the client has been disposed after the database load resolves, the method returns without installing synchronization or invoking onLoad.
If this client is newer than a peer, it announces its schema, marks a full database write as required, and triggers persistence instead of applying the peer message.

If this client is older than a peer within five seconds of initialization, onLoadError receives the schema-mismatch error; after five seconds the client marks itself reloading and requests a window reload.
Messages with the current schema and type diff are applied to the store; announce messages do not apply changes.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Database load failures and migration failures are reported through onLoadError; incompatible schema messages are either reported through onLoadError during the initial five-second window or cause a page reload afterward.
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: Promise<void> resolves after handling the error path; initialization callbacks and state changes depend on the specific failure.

Merges migrated document records and session state into the store.
eventsEmitted: Posts an announce message containing the serialized schema on successful channel setup.
Posts an announce message containing the serialized schema when a peer has an older schema.
May trigger a browser window reload for a stale client after the schema safety window.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Loads with { sessionId: this.sessionId }. Sends synchronization messages shaped as { type: 'announce', schema: this.serializedSchema }; consumes messages with schema, type, and for diff messages a changes payload.
detail.summary: Loads and migrates the client session from IndexedDB, initializes the store and cross-tab synchronization channel, and invokes the appropriate load callback. It applies compatible persisted records and session state while handling storage, migration, and schema incompatibility failures.

detail.name: schedulePersist
postconditions: If a persistence timeout is already pending, no new timeout is scheduled.
If no persistence timeout is pending, a timeout is stored and its callback is registered to clear the timeout marker and invoke persistIfNeeded.
invariants: At most one persistence timeout is scheduled through this method at a time.
edgeCases: When scheduledPersistTimeout is truthy, the method returns without scheduling another timeout.
When scheduledPersistTimeout is falsy, the method schedules a timeout and stores its handle.
When the scheduled callback runs, scheduledPersistTimeout is set to null before persistIfNeeded is invoked.
stateMutations: The deferred callback assigns this.scheduledPersistTimeout to null.
detail.summary: Schedules a deferred persistence attempt only when one is not already scheduled. The scheduled callback clears the pending marker before invoking conditional persistence.

specTests.then: A timeout is scheduled, its handle is assigned to this.scheduledPersistTimeout, and no immediate persistence call occurs.
The existing timeout remains unchanged and no additional timeout is scheduled.

units.name: persistIfNeeded

detail.name: persistIfNeeded
preconditions: The client instance has initialized persistence state, a scheduled persistence timeout field, a store, and a debug facility.
postconditions: Any existing scheduled persistence timeout is cleared and the scheduled timeout reference is set to null.
No new persistence operation is started when persistence is already in progress.
No new persistence operation is started while the client is reloading.
No new persistence operation is started when the store reports possible corruption.
invariants: An active persistence operation is never started concurrently by this method.
A possibly corrupted store is never persisted by this method.
A newer client's changes are not overwritten while this client is reloading.
edgeCases: When a scheduled persistence timeout exists, it is cleared before further checks and the field is reset to null.
When persistence is already in progress, the method returns without starting another persistence operation.
When the page is reloading, the method returns without persisting.
When the store reports possible corruption, the method returns without persisting.
When none of the early-return conditions apply, persistence eligibility is evaluated using the full-write flag and diff-queue state.
stateMutations: Sets scheduledPersistTimeout to null when a scheduled timeout is cleared.
detail.summary: Evaluates whether a local persistence operation should proceed. It cancels any scheduled persistence and avoids starting persistence while another operation is active, the page is reloading, or the store may be corrupted.

specTests.then: The timeout is cleared, scheduledPersistTimeout becomes null, and no additional persistence operation is started.
The method returns without starting persistence.

units.name: doPersist

detail.name: doPersist
preconditions: No other persistence operation is currently in progress.
The client has not been disposed.
postconditions: The persistence-in-progress flag is cleared after the persistence attempt.
The current diff queue is replaced with an empty queue before the database write.
A successful write clears the last-write-error flag.
A failed write requests a full database write on the next attempt and sets the last-write-error flag.
invariants: Diffs arriving while the database operation is in progress remain in the newly active diff queue and are not included in the detached queue for the current write.
Full snapshot writes include the store schema, serialized store snapshot, session ID, and current session-state snapshot.
Incremental writes exclude UPDATE_INSTANCE_STATE entries and persist the remaining diffs after squashing.
edgeCases: If the client is already disposed, the method returns without changing persistence state or writing to IndexedDB.
If a full write is requested, the full-write flag is cleared before the asynchronous database operation; a failure restores the request for a future full write.
If the diff queue contains only UPDATE_INSTANCE_STATE entries, the incremental write receives the result of squashing an empty filtered list.
If the IndexedDB write rejects, the error is swallowed after logging, the alert is shown, and the browser is reloaded when window is available.
If persistence is invoked while another persistence operation is active, the assertion fails before the queue is modified.

raises: Assertion failure with message 'persist already in progress' when persistence is already in progress.
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Not applicable; the method has no parameters. Database write failures are caught and converted into retry state, an alert, and an optional browser reload.
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: Resolves with undefined after handled database-write failures; the concurrency assertion is not handled by this method.

stateMutations: Sets isPersisting to true during the persistence attempt and back to false afterward.
Replaces diffQueue with an empty array while retaining the detached queue for the current write.
Clears shouldDoFullDBWrite before a full snapshot attempt and sets it to true when any database write fails.
Sets didLastWriteError to false after success and true after failure.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Full writes call storeSnapshot({ schema, snapshot, sessionId, sessionStateSnapshot }). Incremental writes call storeChanges({ changes, schema, sessionId, sessionStateSnapshot }), where changes is the squashed diff queue after removing UPDATE_INSTANCE_STATE entries.
detail.summary: Persists the queued local store changes to IndexedDB, using either a full snapshot or squashed record diffs. Failed writes are marked for a later full rewrite and trigger the user alert and browser reload behavior.

specLiterals.role: Assertion message for concurrent persistence attempts.
